info.title: Qaryati API
info.description: Palestinian village knowledge. Public reads include DRAFT records. Register as READER; administrators assign write roles. Updates, verification and deletion require current record version; creation does not. API v1 is independent of record version. Sign in at POST /api/v1/auth/login, copy accessToken into Authorize (token only). Expired/revoked sessions require a new login. Passwords are 12–128 characters. Unknown body/query fields are rejected. Examples are synthetic.
